title: Budgeting on a variable income
description: A plan of obligatory expenses in which money received and money expected are kept apart. You can see which payments are already covered by income and what changes when income is late.

blocks.text: A freelancer’s income changes from one payment to the next, while some expenses have known dates. A fixed monthly salary describes such a plan badly. What is needed is a link between money already received and the nearest obligations.

quote.text: I love this app a lot. My income is different every paycheck since I’m a freelancer and a lot of budgeting apps don’t have a good interface for inconsistent income. This app though works wonders for that problem.

blocks.text: Start from the dates of the obligatory payments and the funds available. Keep the income expected as a separate scenario. After new income arrives, suggest an allocation the person can change, while keeping the payments not yet covered in view.

Work through a delay to one incoming payment. It should be visible which obligations it affected, without giving the impression that expected money is already available. The percentages held in reserve and the financial decisions are the person’s own; the interface helps them see the calculation.
